direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling; all targets at least 36px, rail targets equal width, non-wrapping, with aria-current and arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) for secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A as sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, an x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum and no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls, never conflating them; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge the left factory scene toward 70% of main by narrowing the right evidence zone about 8% and increasing station and job card height within the reserved scene zone.
Raise right-zone body copy and Source detail labels to a clear 16px/24, keeping the 120, 80 and 100 metrics tabular and aligned to the scene tracks.
Add a visible 2px emerald focus ring with offset to the Inspect source evidence primary and to focusable RECEIVING, CELL-MILL-1 and CELL-MILL-2 nodes.
Separate connection readiness and investigation more strongly with two titled reserved panels, distinct status lines and controls, so provider identity checking is never read as the evidence task.
Refit the right zone so the bottom explanatory panel fits fully at 1366x768 without crowding the action bar, condensing narration to one instruction and one status sentence.
Enlarge the scene zone and make the primary Run action reachable after the route check control in tab order, with aria-live polite announcing the check result.
Condense the lower investigation notebook inside its reserved zone so all validated result rows fit at 1366x768 with 16px body type and no clipped final row.
Keep the collapsed connection check visually subordinate and clearly separate from the expanded source-evidence results, with its own status text.
Highlight the scene nodes tied to the validated 120 claim bidirectionally when the notebook row is focused or selected.
Increase the three Select this path controls to at least 44px tall with 16px labels and a clear emerald selected state before the typed consent form opens.
Reduce the empty lower right area by enlarging the comparison and Human decision zones vertically inside their reserved column, keeping No acceptance recorded prominent.
Mirror the focused recovery path in the left scene with emerald route emphasis while keeping unselected paths in brushed silver.
Make the three proposed task cards keyboard-focusable in sequence with 2px emerald focus rings, and sync focus with the numbered 1, 2, 3 proposal pager in the side zone.
Clarify progress bars on proposed cards by labelling them as schedule spans rather than completion, since the proposal remains untracked until approval.
Enlarge station cards at the top of the scene so CELL-MILL-1 40h and CELL-MILL-2 24h capacity read as the dominant accepted-plan evidence.
Strengthen the CELL-MILL-2 preview with denser silver cross-hatching plus a clear x marker and plain OFFLINE preview text inside the station, while retaining no route through it after application.
Raise the side-zone selector label and consequence copy to 16px/24 and give the machine selector a visible emerald focus ring.
Make the 24h to 0h preview metric larger and tabular, aligned with the affected station in the scene.
Separate the connection readiness panel from the Investigation not run evidence panel with stronger headings, spacing and independent status so the two tasks remain unmistakably distinct.
Add plain OFFLINE text directly inside the cross-hatched CELL-MILL-2 station at readable size, paired with the x marker already spanning the card.
Show the constrained Split option in the scene footer with silver hatching and x CONSTRAINED text matching the side state, keeping only two feasible paths in emerald when selected.
Give the two available Select this path controls equal width, at least 44px height and 16px labels; keep the constrained Split row non-interactive with silver hatching, x marker and reason text.
Fill the empty lower right zone by enlarging the Human decision panel and adding the invalidated prior acceptance summary inside that reserved zone.
Make Review revised option open the typed consent form only after a path is selected, and announce the selection through aria-live polite.

Keep blocked prior tasks and proposed replacements in visually separate reserved groups with distinct silver hatching for blocked and dashed emerald outline for proposed untracked tasks, as the header counts already state.
Sync keyboard focus between the three scene task cards and both side-zone pagers so t1, t2 and t3 never highlight different tasks in different zones.
Reduce repetition between the scene footer status and the side awaiting-approval line to one status sentence, freeing height for larger task titles.
Add a visible Complete state to the compact horizontal rail item 10 matching the header Proof tab, with aria-current on the final step.
Make Verify ledger, Export independent checkpoint and the advanced downloads disclosure at least 44px tall with 16px labels and emerald focus rings.
Link the three SEALED scene cards bidirectionally to the retained evidence rows so focus on a card highlights Verify ledger, Seal packet or Retain checkpoint respectively.
